hooks.command: codeflow hook git-guard --contract 3; codeflow_status=$?; if [ "$codeflow_status" -ne 0 ]; then codeflow_ok=; if command -v codeflow >/dev/null 2>&1 && codeflow_dir=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/codeflow-probe.XXXXXX" 2>/dev/null); then (codeflow git-hook capabilities </dev/null >"$codeflow_dir/out" 2>/dev/null & echo "$!" >"$codeflow_dir/pid"; wait "$!"; echo "$?" >"$codeflow_dir/rc") 2>/dev/null & codeflow_pid=$!; codeflow_wait=20; while [ "$codeflow_wait" -gt 0 ] && [ ! -s "$codeflow_dir/rc" ]; do sleep 0.1 2>/dev/null || sleep 1; codeflow_wait=$((codeflow_wait - 1)); done; if [ -s "$codeflow_dir/rc" ]; then read -r codeflow_rc 2>/dev/null <"$codeflow_dir/rc"; if [ "$codeflow_rc" = 0 ] && grep -qx 'hooks 3' "$codeflow_dir/out"; then codeflow_ok=1; fi; else codeflow_child=; read -r codeflow_child 2>/dev/null <"$codeflow_dir/pid"; case $codeflow_child in ''|*[!0-9]*) codeflow_child=;; esac; kill -9 $codeflow_child "$codeflow_pid" 2>/dev/null; wait "$codeflow_pid" 2>/dev/null; fi; rm -f "$codeflow_dir/out" "$codeflow_dir/pid" "$codeflow_dir/rc"; rmdir "$codeflow_dir" 2>/dev/null; fi; if [ -z "$codeflow_ok" ]; then echo "codeflow: hook binary missing or older; install with: curl -fsSL https://github.com/sathyassn/codeflow/releases/latest/download/codeflow-cli-installer.sh | sh ; then run codeflow update" >&2; fi; exit 2; fi
